name: KCC Corporation
summary: KCC Corporation provides building materials in South Korea and internationally. It provides building materials such as, celling; insulation; gypsum board; and flooring materials. The company also offers window profiles, balcony window profiles, system window profiles, and sense doors; interior decorative materials, such as flooring materials and laminate films; float, functional, and automotive glass products; decorative, automotive, marine, plant, and industrial coatings; and organic and inorganic materials.
